posts.author: rhea_c
posts.body: We use personal API tokens in a nightly integration. I cannot find anything in the older docs about expiration. Do tokens ever expire automatically?

posts.author: samit_dev
posts.body: On our workspace they have stayed valid for months. We only replace them if someone leaves.

posts.author: openops_mila
posts.body: At the moment personal tokens do not expire automatically. If you need a safer setup, use a service account and rotate the token on your own schedule.
